intended_use: Educational clinical decision support: fuse a chest X-ray, free-text symptom notes, and tabular heart or diabetes features into an explainable report. Not a medical device.
disclaimer: Outputs are not a diagnosis, prescription, or treatment plan. Always consult a qualified clinician.

modalities.name: Chest X-ray
modalities.architecture: ResNet50 (primary) with a tiny CNN baseline; Grad-CAM explanations
modalities.training_data: Pediatric chest X-ray dataset (Kermany / Guangzhou), JPEG images resized to 224×224. Current metrics were recorded in quick-mode on a small held-out split (n_test ≈ 32).
modalities.evaluation_set: Held-out test split from the same source; see Performance for confusion matrices and ROC AUC.
known_failure_modes: Adult or portable ICU films differ from the pediatric training distribution.
Devices, text overlays, and rotated or cropped images can distract Grad-CAM.
Viral vs bacterial pneumonia is not distinguished; other findings (effusion, masses) are out of scope.
Quick-mode metrics are not a substitute for a full external validation.
modalities.intended_use: Highlight regions that influence a pneumonia vs normal score.

modalities.name: Symptom notes
modalities.architecture: DistilBERT (and logistic regression baseline) with LIME word attributions
modalities.task: Multi-class symptom-text classification (24 labels including Pneumonia, diabetes, Hypertension, Common Cold)
modalities.training_data: Symptom-description corpus with a label and free-text column. Quick-mode used a few hundred rows (n_test ≈ 24).
modalities.evaluation_set: Held-out text split; macro F1 and confusion matrices are on the Performance page.
known_failure_modes: Short, misspelled, or mixed-language notes reduce LIME stability.
Labels are coarse disease names, not ICD codes or severity.
Mentions of family history or negations ('no cough') can be misread.
Not trained on clinical notes with abbreviations or EHR templates.
modalities.intended_use: Surface which words pushed the symptom classifier toward a label.

modalities.name: Heart and diabetes risk
modalities.architecture: Logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and MLP with SHAP contributions (primary model is the best validated tabular estimator)
modalities.task: Binary risk scoring on Cleveland heart disease features and Pima-style diabetes features
modalities.training_data: UCI Cleveland heart (303 rows, 13 features) and Pima Indians Diabetes (768 rows, 8 features). Standard train/validation/test splits with seed 42.
modalities.evaluation_set: Heart n_test ≈ 46; diabetes n_test ≈ 116. Threshold 0.5. See Performance for AUC, calibration, and confusion matrices.
known_failure_modes: Cohorts are older, hospital-based (heart) or specific (Pima diabetes); they do not represent all patients.
Missing labs filled or clipped to UI ranges can distort SHAP.
Sex is encoded as in the original tables; it is not a clinical sex/gender assessment.
Risk is not a 10-year ASCVD or HbA1c forecast.
modalities.intended_use: Show which entered labs raise or lower a prototype risk score.
